name: Higashikagawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Higashikagawa city emblem in white and green: a white stylised bird with a green wing.
history: Municipal flag of Higashikagawa, a city in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2003.

features.role: Higashikagawa city emblem — a white stylised bird with a green wing
